_comment: W5 WALK probe (D84). Proves the scripted-menu-walk driver machinery headless with NO game (probe conf = empty autoexec): boot trap (BPLM on the BDA tick cell 0x46C) -> boot_writes at the ACCEPT stop (frame 0) -> WALK phase on the still-armed BPLM: stop-indexed SMV writes with stop 2 a pure skip (proves indexing), two rows on stop 3, and a per-stop calibration watch dumped write-then-read (riding the transcript as '# walk stop N ...' comments) -> arm at the LAST walk stop (BPDEL * + BPINT 8 surrogate anchor) -> resolve_at=anchor (the D84 position: symbols read at the anchor stop, feeding expr lens) -> anchor/per-frame capture. The gate asserts: walk-note write-then-read per stop, the skip-stop indexing, the anchor resolve value, the expr len evaluated from it, and stable state rows. These ids are deliberately NOT registry ids - a probe transcript is never stitched.
